key_insight: The paper introduces integer hybrid path-sums (IHPS), a new analysis framework that extends path-sums to model hybrid quantum programs with unbounded loops and support effective verification plus resource estimation.
engineering_relevance: It provides a semi-automated static analysis approach for checking termination and expected cost in realistic quantum-classical programs, which is important for building dependable quantum software tools.
method: Extends path-sums to represent possible executions with unbounded while loops.
Uses loop invariants to infer termination and expected resource consumption.
Implements the approach in a semi-automatic Haskell prototype.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports the method is demonstrated on several examples and implemented as a semi-automatic Haskell program, but it does not provide quantitative benchmark results.
watch_item: The approach is still a prototype and depends on finding suitable loop invariants, which may limit scalability or automation in complex programs.
paper_title: An Effective Quantum Hoare Logic for Hybrid Quantum Programs with Unbounded Loops
